envelope.description: Add the patch parser and the section reconciliation

body.title: Add the patch parser and the section reconciliation
body.summary: New pure module vscode-plugin/src/chat/diff-sections.ts: DiffSection, SectionOp, KnownSection, the three limits, parsePatch and reconcileSections, with its test file. Nothing uses it yet.
acceptanceChecks: parsePatch gives one entry per section with path, ranges, counts and lines, and handles a new, a deleted and a binary file, a name with a space and a quoted name
A section over 400 lines is cut with the rest counted in omitted
reconcileSections adds, updates under the same id, withdraws, joins, and hides sections beyond the limit

tests.name: parsePatch: one entry per section, with path, ranges, counts and lines, for two sections of one file
parsePatch: a new file, a deleted file, a binary file, a name with a space and a quoted name
parsePatch: a section over 400 lines is cut, the rest counted in omitted, and added and removed count the whole section
parsePatch: an empty patch gives no sections and an unreadable file part is skipped without a throw
reconcileSections: a new section is added, an unchanged one gives no operation and a changed one is updated under the same id
reconcileSections: sections that join update the lower id and withdraw the other, and a section that is gone is withdrawn
reconcileSections: beyond the limit new sections are kept hidden, counted in overflow, and never produce an operation later
